video.title: Working in the Wild (Holly Akello)
video.transcript: Holly Akello doesn't have an ordinary job! She looks after wild animals at a conservation center in Uganda. Holly is positive and enthusiastic about her job. She likes to be with animals. I feel so lucky that I'm in the field doing what I've always dreamed of doing. The 23-year-old takes care of all kinds of animals-from snakes to hyenas. Some people think it's a dangerous job, but it's always an adventure, and she loves it! At the conservation center, Holly gets training and learns skills she uses every day. She's responsible for preparing food and feeding the lions. She gives them their meal. Then she sits down to spend time and communicate with them. I'm not afraid of wildlife. Because, I think, if you're able to understand them, it becomes so easy for you to work with them.

video.title: Life in a Day (Ridley Scott)
video.transcript: In 2010, Ridley Scott started an extraordinary project called Life in a Day. He asked people to film their lives on one specific day. He received 80,000 videos from 192 countries. The project shows that although we live in different places, our lives are often similar. The film connects us by showing both typical moments and extraordinary events. It is a massive contribution to our understanding of global culture. Some videos show normal activities like eating breakfast or going to work. Others show strange events and beautiful views. A banal day can contribute to a large global project. Technology helps us realize that we are part of a massive population.

audio.title: Meet the Explorers (Thandiwe & Ricardo)
audio.transcript: Different people have different views about big cats, such as lions and jaguars. Some people think the animals are beautiful, but other people are afraid of them because they can be dangerous. Thandiwe Mweetwa and Ricardo Samuel Moreno are biologists, and they love to explore the natural world. Thandiwe is from Zambia, and she helps lions in her country. Sometimes people kill these animals because they want to protect their farm animals. So Thandiwe communicates with people in the villages and shares her experiences. Ricardo is from Panama, and he often goes on adventures in the jungle. It's difficult, and it takes special skills. He has to find creative ways to photograph them. For example, he uses special cameras in the trees.

audio.title: Social Media Presentation
audio.transcript: In my presentation, I talked about the advantages and disadvantages of social media in our lives. In conclusion, I think social media can be good for us, but we need to teach people to use it safely. Thank you all for listening to my presentation. I have time for a few questions. Student 1: Hi. Thank you for your interesting talk. How do we use social media safely? Presenter: People need to be careful online. For example, when you post something personal, your friends can see it. But strangers might see it too. Does that make sense? Student 2: I'd like to know which social media older people use. Presenter: I'm not exactly sure of the answer because that information comes from a survey about teenagers. But I can probably find out for you.
